Privacy

Chats, settings and memories are stored in this browser. Messages, selected file contents and enabled memory notes are sent to the configured AI provider when you send. Device/browser speech services may process speech or read-aloud text remotely.

Sharing sends only the text you review to the selected app. Deleting local chats does not delete provider records, exported files or other devices. Account deletion and cloud retention need account setup.
